policy: A gate passes only when its evidence record is explicitly marked pass and bound to the exact current runtime and GLB SHA-256 values.

stowed_silhouette_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser visual review at desktop and 390x844
stowed_silhouette_reviewed.evidence: Stowed 1.0.2 machine rendered from the exact GLB with nested outer/inner guards, zero runtime errors and selection self-test pass on 2026-08-25.

raised_pose_browser_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser full-lift and full-extension visual review
raised_pose_browser_reviewed.evidence: Full lift plus 0.55 m extension rendered continuously with rear-fixed stack, closed rail/toe-board boundary and dynamic bounds framing on desktop and 390x844 on 2026-08-25.

extension_browser_reviewed.method: Local browser stowed/mid/full-extension review plus six-pair GLB AABB continuity gate
extension_browser_reviewed.evidence: Fixed outer and moving inner top rails, mid rails and toe boards remain nested with 0.568 m, 0.293 m and 0.018 m overlap at 0, 50 and 100 percent travel. The 0.55 m full-extension view has no guard opening, zero runtime errors and a motion-correct platform hit volume.

steering_boundary_reviewed.method: Static contract and local browser boundary review
steering_boundary_reviewed.evidence: Actuator output remains bounded to 80 mm each direction and both unsupported spindle rotations remain exactly neutral.

accessibility_reviewed.method: Keyboard dialog review in local in-app browser plus native-control event-boundary inspection
accessibility_reviewed.evidence: Initial close-button focus, Tab containment, Escape close, exact About-opener focus restoration and About content reset passed. Viewer shortcuts now return without preventDefault for inputs, selects, textareas, buttons and editable targets.

desktop_browser_zero_errors.method: Local in-app browser diagnostics and console inspection
desktop_browser_zero_errors.evidence: Exact GLB loaded with runtime error count zero, no console warnings/errors, and stable 60-61 fps diagnostic sampling.

mobile_and_pinch_reviewed.method: 390x844 browser layout review plus deterministic synthetic two-pointer gesture validator
mobile_and_pinch_reviewed.evidence: Collapsed and expanded mobile layouts were visually reviewed; five synthetic pinch cases proved monotonic in/out zoom, stable invalid baseline, and both distance clamps. No physical touchscreen claim is made.

selection_and_focus_reviewed.method: Three-state rig self-test plus local canvas selection
selection_and_focus_reviewed.evidence: Dynamic platform/scissor volumes passed stowed, mid and full poses; canvas hit selected chassis and opened the correct inspector.

performance_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser rolling frame sample
performance_reviewed.evidence: Exact 1.0.2 runtime reported 60-61 fps and 17.0-17.5 ms p95 with selection self-test pass and zero runtime errors on 2026-08-25.

600s_regression_suite_pass.evidence: Viewer, evidence, configuration and exact 600S GLB validators passed on 2026-08-25; the accepted receipt remains SHOWCASE_V1_1_ACCEPTED with mobile_view_reviewed true.
